notes:
Condition estimates now carry an evidence-based reliability score: photo detail, sharpness, glare, measurement agreement, coverage and distance to a grade boundary, computed by the shared rulebook instead of trusting the model's self-report. The Worker reports observations only; the app measures each mark and applies the TCGplayer rubric.

Connectivity failures now say the phone is offline instead of naming a Java exception.

Debug build of the PocketVaultTCG Android app (debug-signed). Sideload for testing.
